arguments:
set -eu
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCOUNT=$(stat -c %U "$APP")
printf 'APP_OWNER=%s\n' "$ACCOUNT"
printf 'DEPLOYED_SHA='; sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'WORKTREE='; if [ -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCOUNT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)" ]; then echo clean; else echo dirty; fi
printf 'SERVICE='; systemctl is-active lowcost-europa.service
printf 'NGINX='; systemctl is-active nginx.service
printf 'POSTGRES='; systemctl is-active postgresql.service
printf 'REPORT_TIMER='; systemctl is-active lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.timer
printf 'READY_LOCAL='; curl -sS --max-time 5 -H 'Host: lowcost-europa.duckdns.org' -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8001/health/ready/; echo
printf 'VENV='; if [ -x "$APP/.venv/bin/python" ]; then echo present; else echo absent; fi
printf 'BACKUP_LATEST='; sudo -n find /var/backups/lowcost-europa/daily -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'lowcost-europa-*.dump' -printf '%T@ %f\n' | sort -nr | head -n 1 | cut -d' ' -f2-
printf 'OFFSITE_MARKER='; if sudo -n test -f /var/lib/lowcost-europa/offsite-backup.last-success; then echo present; else echo absent; fi
printf 'FREE_MB='; df -Pm "$APP" | awk 'NR==2{print $4}'
